annotation.interpretation_a: IANA is required to add the registry if it does not already exist.
annotation.interpretation_b: IANA may have already added the registry, and this clause simply acknowledges that fact.
annotation.justification: The phrase "SHALL add/has added" is ambiguous. It's unclear whether this is a requirement to add the registry if it doesn't exist, or simply a statement that the registry has been or will be added. This affects implementation because a reader might incorrectly assume the registry is already present when it isn't.
